text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
-- Euphoria on the Lisbon bourse, prices have risen 10 percent since the beginning of the year.
-- Struggling TVI television station warns of layoffs.
-- Algarve tourism in crisis. Hotels cut prices.
-- Expo 98: accounts are all wrong. The exhibition is going to be more expensive than expected.
-- Lisbon water prices to rise two percent.
-- United States and Jews put Portugal "under siege" over Nazi gold.
-- Jeronimo Martins sales rose 27.7 percent in 1996 to 359.6 billion escudos.
-- TAP negotiates with Thai Airways on Macau route.
